name: E02_3_crossway_troublemakers_not_the_opponents_vampire_not_a_blocking_one
notes: G2 verifier, batch E. Printed: 'Attacking Vampires you control have deathtouch and lifelink.' It is seat 1's turn. Seat 1's Vampire (1/9) attacks and seat 0's Vampire (1/9) blocks it. Seat 1's attacker is an attacking Vampire but not one seat 0 controls: no deathtouch (seat 0's Vampire survives with 1 damage) and no lifelink (seat 1 stays at 20). Seat 0's blocker is a Vampire seat 0 controls but not attacking: no deathtouch (seat 1's Vampire survives with 1 damage) and no lifelink (seat 0 stays at 20).
